Optical setup for a pure spectrum. Left to right: A light source, a narrow vertical slit, a converging lens (collimator) producing parallel horizontal lines of white light, a triangular prism bending the rays, another converging lens (telescope), and a white screen. The rays exiting the prism are shown as distinct parallel bundles of red, green, and violet light, which are then focused to sharp points on the screen.
